title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
synopsis: California suburb. Your parents split. A creature with a glowing finger is in your shed. He wants to go home.

nodes.text: Something rustles. Reese's Pieces lead it to your room.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Lure with candy.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Confront.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He hides among stuffed animals. He blinks.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
“Tell Mom” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Your little sister sees him. He, somehow, is okay with this.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Friend.
There is no taking “Swear her to secrecy” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You feel what he feels. Sometimes drunk, sometimes sad.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You release the frogs in science class. You kiss Erika.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Just go with it” back. Joy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Apologize after” back. Civil shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He builds a radio out of an umbrella and a saw blade.

choices.consequence: “Help him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Friend.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Selfish—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He needs to broadcast from a hill.

choices.text: Carry the radio in your bike
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Carry the radio in your bike” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.

nodes.text: He turns gray. You turn gray.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Mom finds him. Government men in suits arrive.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hide him” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Cooperate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: The house becomes a hospital.

choices.consequence: “Stay by his side” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Friend.
You commit to “Stay out of the way.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: His heart flickers. So does yours.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.
“Step back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: He stops glowing. You break.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Mourn.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Refuse to mourn.” The story records the instinct as “Hope” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The flower blooms. He whispers your name.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Mike and his friends. Bikes. A van.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Steal the van” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Run on foot” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Police behind. You pedal. He, in the basket, lifts the bikes.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Spaceship lands. Lights through trees.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.

nodes.text: They arrive. Gertie hands him a flower.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Hug them.” The story records the instinct as “Love” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: He touches his finger to your forehead. He'll be right here.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
There is no taking “Smile” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He climbs aboard. The ship rises. The rainbow stripes are in the sky.

choices.consequence: “Wave” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Mom's hand on your shoulder. The house is small. The world is bigger.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Eat dinner.” The story records the instinct as “Routine” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.

nodes.text: Years later you keep the dead flower in a book.

choices.consequence: “Open the book sometimes” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Sentiment.
You commit to “Keep it closed.” The story records the instinct as “Memory” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You become an astronaut. You don't, in the end, meet him again. The stars are, you find, enough.
You become a teacher in the same town. Gertie becomes a doctor. Mom remarries kindly. The flower is, still, in the book.
You write the story down for kids who don't believe in much anymore. They believe. Some of them, after, build radios out of unlikely parts.
